name: University of East London
description: The University of East London is a public university with campuses at Stratford and Docklands in east London, which gained university status in 1992 and traces its roots to the West Ham Technical Institute of 1898. It has a large and fast-growing international postgraduate intake.
whyIncluded: The University of East London is among the 10 universities in the United Kingdom most chosen by international students (13,230 non-UK students in 2024-25, HESA), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

programmes.name: BSc (Hons) Computer Science
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for international students starting in 2026. UEL may raise fees each year (capped at 5%), so later years could cost a little more.
programmes.notes: UEL Fees Schedule 2026-27 (Schedule 1 to the Tuition Fees Policy, fetched 2026-10-07), section 1.2 International Students, undergraduate full-time: Architecture, Computing and Engineering (ACE) school: 'All Schools' rate £16,020 for 2026/27 entry (footnote: ACE pre-2026/27 entry £15,720). 2025-26 schedule: all schools £15,560 but footnote 'Updated November 2025: fee of £15,300 also applies to ACE Undergraduate International 2025/26 entry', so £15,300 is used for 2025. 2024-25 schedule: School of Architecture, Computing & Engineering £14,580 (all other schools £14,820). History from the same section of the 2025-26 schedule (£15,300) and the 2024-25 schedule (£14,580). 3-year full-time route; an optional placement year costs £1,500. UEL's Tuition Fees Policy says international fees may increase each year in line with inflation by no more than RPI-X plus 3%, for new and continuing students, and its course pages say any annual increase is capped at 5% of the previous year's fee, so cohortLocked is false. No separate compulsory fees; the international deposit is credited to tuition.
